doc.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Joe Williams and Ethel Merman on the Tonight Show
summary: Joe Williams appeared often on the show; he and Ethel Merman were easy to accompany.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Now Joe Williams did a few appearances on the Tonight Show.
Oh, how many? I don’t know, a hundred?
Oh, Lord, yeah. Carson loved him, yeah. And the audience did too. And I mean even when he wasn’t scheduled, if somebody’d fall out, you know one of the guests would not appear or something—
Joe was living in Vegas, he’d just come in, and half the time he’d sing a blues and we’d make up some riffs.

The two easiest people over the years that Doc Severinsen and I used to like to see, and this is going to sound ridiculous, were Ethel Merman and Joe Williams. They only did one take and heard the full run of it. They’d run it through once, that’s it. And that’s the only two people.
